environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in us-east-1 VPC with public ALB. Task definition uses 512MB memory, 256 CPU units. Service runs with awsvpc networking mode, security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB target group health check on /health. No request throttling configured. Service auto-scales on CPU utilization (target 70%). Container image built with Go 1.21, CGO_ENABLED=0.
